description: This file contains advanced unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler functionality, including tests for task execution order, context preservation, continuation behaviors, and scheduler interactions within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests
classes.description: A comprehensive set of unit tests for Orleans task scheduler, including scenarios for task ordering, context management, fault handling, and scheduler behavior.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Test
methods.description: Tests whether scheduled tasks execute serially, verifying no concurrent execution occurs.

methods.name: Sched_AC_WaitTest
methods.description: Tests proper waiting and execution order between dependent tasks.

methods.name: SubProcess1
methods.description: A helper method to record execution step 1 with context validation.

methods.name: SubProcess2
methods.description: A helper method to record execution step 2 with context validation.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Verifies that a turn completes fully before the next begins, including interruption and concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: Sched_Stopped_WorkItemGroup
methods.description: Validates behavior of scheduler when work item groups are stopped and restarted.

methods.name: Sched_Task_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Checks task turn execution order, ensuring long and short tasks run in correct sequence.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Current_TaskScheduler
methods.description: Verifies that the current TaskScheduler inside nested tasks matches the expected activation scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_1_Test
methods.description: Tests chaining of tasks with continuations and correct execution sequence.

methods.name: Sched_Task_JoinAll
methods.description: Tests the behavior of Task.WhenAll on multiple scheduled tasks, including timing and completion validation.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_2_OrleansSched
methods.description: Verifies that ContinueWith properly propagates errors and executes handlers when using Orleans task scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SchedulingContext
methods.description: Ensures that tasks executed in a scheduling context preserve the runtime context correctly.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Helper method for logging execution details during tests.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates the current runtime and activation context match expected context.
